findings.finding: ResearchCase identity does not own planning authority.
findings.resolution: Authority is versioned on CaseControlSummaryVersion; ResearchCase status only reflects the lane state.

findings.finding: A kill switch could prevent the very rollback it needs to trigger.
findings.resolution: Only PlanningLaneCutoverService rollback uses a bounded rollback_control transaction; ordinary writes remain denied.

findings.finding: A cutover approval could be replayed against changed schema/policy/artifact/comparison inputs.
findings.resolution: Approval receipt and request bind all four digests and expiry before request persistence.

findings.finding: Legacy compatibility could reintroduce a dual authoritative writer.
findings.resolution: Projection is immutable/read-only and contains explicit information-loss tags; no legacy mutation API exists.

findings.finding: Case-scoped pilot logic could accidentally extend to sector/global scope.
findings.resolution: Feature flag and eligibility schema allow only scope_kind=case; sector/tenant/global are forbidden admissions.

user_confirmation.notes: Current-thread human reviewer explicitly approved the M4.0 design review. This approval prepares, but does not execute, a case-scoped pilot cutover.
